hypothesis: A target-learned risk-function discrepancy can correct source variance shrinkage while retaining the learned source covariance.
single_change: For eta only, C_target_prior = C_source_prior + delta * diag(0, 1/F, ..., 1/F), delta >= 0; F is the existing 68-function public dictionary size.
preserved: Original source priors, zero nonintercept coefficient means, intercept variance, per-candidate discrepancy, f/g updates, paid observations, dictionary, recommendation utility and verifier.
delta_fit: One scalar per seed/regime/prior/prefix, estimated from paid target eta labels by marginal likelihood. Learned eta uses a common delta for both original components and marginalizes their initial equal weights; generic eta has the same correction family.
model_covariance: Include the source function covariance, repeated-candidate shared discrepancy and declared log-variance label noise in the training likelihood.
validation: Nested leave-one-candidate-out predictive log score. Refit delta using training candidates only, excluding every replicate-batch row at the held-out candidate. Use the joint predictive density for its repeated observations.
scoring: Report all regime/prior groups and paired old-seed changes. Candidate features and paid eta labels are the only fit/validation inputs; truth/support enter post-fit scoring only.
recommendation_replay: If grouped predictive validation supports the added freedom, re-estimate eta on all paid prefix data, retaining f/g posteriors and the original queries. Label fitted-hyperparameter uncertainty and retrospective recommendation evidence explicitly.
interpretation: Tests target correction freedom, not target sparse-support identification, closed-loop superiority or source-free initialization.
stop_rule: No new closed-loop pilot if predictive gains rely on leaked repeated-candidate observations, fail across the retained strata, or turn into additional severe recommendation losses. Keep incomplete and negative results.
numerical_fit: Collapse repeated labels to precision-weighted candidate means; use shared candidate discrepancy. Whiten covariance for scalar likelihood evaluation; bound delta by the point where every component log-density decreases, search 65 log(1+delta) nodes, and refine grid maxima including the boundary intervals.
